html:
Question 2
?

Consider a function f(t) for which the Laplace transform is L{f(t)}=F(s). How can we obtain the graph of L{e−9tf(t)} from the graph of F(s)?

a
The Laplace transform is unchanged.
b
Scale the graph of F(s) by a scale factor of 9 vertically.
c
Shift the graph of F(s) by 9 units to the right.
d
Shift the graph of F(s) by 9 units to the left.
e
Scale the graph of F(s) by a scale factor of 9 horizontally.
